#HMPV in Other Countries
In other countries, #HMPvirus may well be circulating. The virus is known to cause illnesses during colder months.

Symptoms include coughing, fever, stuffy or runny nose and shortness of breath.  #chinavirues

Stay Alert and Safe

#HMPV in #Kazakhstan
The Ministry of Health of the Republic of Kazakhstan has reported cases of #HMPvirus as part of an expected seasonal rise of respiratory illnesses. The Committee for Sanitary and Epidemiological Control reported 30 cases of HMPV. #chinavirues
